description: Reads a requested number of bits one at a time from a buffer of longwords read backwards, shifting each bit into an accumulator and loading the next longword when the current one is exhausted; returns the accumulated value.

name: patch_jump_vectors_after_check
description: Calls a function-pointer slot from a stored table and, if it returns zero, writes absolute-jump opcodes into several code locations that point to a local routine and then jumps through a stored vector. Otherwise it calls two other table slots and compares a returned word against a fixed constant.

name: patch_jump_sites_and_trap
description: Writes absolute-jump opcodes at five code locations that target a local routine, then calls two jump-table entries of the system library base; if both results are non-zero it reads a custom-chip register, stores a constant in a global and raises trap zero.

name: chain_indirect_calls_and_jump
description: Calls the routine whose address is held in address register A0, calls another routine, then makes an indirect jump through a pointer whose target could not be recovered.

name: call_pointer_from_stored_context
description: Loads a stored context pointer and calls the function pointer at a fixed offset inside it; the decompiler output is cut short, so only that call is recovered.

name: store_call_result_indirectly
description: Calls a routine and stores its 32-bit result through the pointer in address register A0, then writes the constant 48 as a 16-bit value at a fixed offset from frame register A6 and returns the data register D0.

name: wait_then_store_handler_address
description: Loops calling a routine until its return value minus 170 reaches a stored limit, then stores the address of a local routine in a global variable.

name: wait_then_store_fixed_address
description: Loops calling a routine until its return value minus 170 reaches a stored limit, then stores a fixed address constant in a global variable.

name: replicate_global_byte_value
description: Returns a 32-bit value built by repeating one global byte three times; the facts also list the CIA time-of-day low register as touched, which the shown body does not read directly.

name: patch_jump_sites_fixed_target
description: Writes absolute-jump opcodes at five code locations, two of them aimed at a fixed address and three at a local routine, then calls jump-table entries of the system library base and raises trap zero when both results are non-zero.

name: patch_jump_sites_fixed_target
description: Writes absolute-jump opcodes at five code locations, two of them aimed at a fixed address and three at a local routine, then calls jump-table entries of the system library base and raises trap zero when both results are non-zero.

name: return_immediately_stub
description: A stub whose decompiled body is only a return with no other effect; the facts count six instructions, so the rest is likely padding after the return.

name: patch_code_by_signature
description: Compares the longword at a base pointer in address register A2 against several fixed signature values and, on a match, overwrites instruction words in place with no-operation or return opcodes or with branch opcodes.

name: write_nop_then_call
description: Writes a no-operation opcode at a fixed offset from address register A2, then calls one routine and returns the data registers unchanged.

name: write_return_then_call
description: Writes a return opcode at a fixed offset from address register A2, then calls one routine and returns the data registers unchanged.

name: patch_branch_opcode_then_call
description: Checks a word at a fixed offset from address register A2 for a conditional-branch opcode and, if found, rewrites it and a second site to unconditional branch opcodes, then calls one routine.

name: patch_branches_and_call_sites
description: Writes unconditional branch opcodes at three fixed offsets from address register A2, writes absolute call opcodes that target a local routine at two other offsets, then calls one routine.

name: forward_call_return_registers
description: Calls one routine and returns the two data registers unchanged; no other work is shown.

name: write_blit_size_from_pointer
description: Copies a word from the pointer in address register A0 into the blitter size register and then busy-waits while the blitter is active.

name: write_blit_size_second_field
description: Copies a word from a pointer in address register A0 into the blitter size register and then busy-waits while the blitter is active, reading from a different field offset than its neighbour.

name: patch_word_pairs_in_range
description: Scans a memory range word by word and, where a fixed two-word pattern appears, rewrites the following longwords with new constants; it first calls two routines and stores a constant in a global variable.

name: fill_range_with_returned_words
description: Repeatedly calls a routine and stores each word it returns at the next address until the end pointer is reached.

name: patch_word_pairs_in_range
description: Scans a memory range word by word and, where a fixed two-word pattern appears, rewrites the following longwords with new constants, then stores a constant in a global variable.

name: rotate_sum_into_word
description: Adds a global value to a stored word and rotates the sum right by one bit, storing the result back; the facts list the video beam-position register as touched, which the shown body does not read.

name: read_word_then_call_slot
description: Reads a word at a fixed offset from address register A3, calls one routine, calls a function pointer stored in the context table, and returns the word read earlier.

name: call_slot_then_chain
description: Calls a function-pointer slot from a stored context and, if it returns non-zero, calls a second slot and then one routine.

name: copy_routine_and_patch_moves
description: Copies the words of a local routine into a destination buffer, then scans a memory range and rewrites matching move instructions into subroutine-call opcodes that target that buffer.

name: write_blit_size_then_wait
description: Writes the data register word into the blitter size register and then busy-waits while the blitter is active.

name: wait_blitter_idle
description: Busy-waits while the blitter busy flag in the custom-chip DMA status is set; the facts list the parallel-port control register, which the body does not read.

name: patch_move_immediates_to_jumps
description: Scans a memory range for word-immediate move instructions with a fixed displacement and rewrites them into absolute-jump opcodes aimed at a local routine, then writes a jump to that routine at a destination.

name: write_blit_size_from_argument
description: Copies a word from a pointer passed on the stack into the blitter size register, then busy-waits while the blitter is active.

name: save_dma_status_around_call
description: Saves the DMA control status word, writes a constant to a global variable, calls one routine and one slot of the context table, then stores the saved status with its top bit set back into the global variable.

name: xor_memory_block_with_counter
description: XORs 388 consecutive bytes starting at a fixed low-memory address with a descending counter byte.

name: convert_nibbles_to_hex_digits
description: Looks up the high and low nibbles of the data register in a hexadecimal digit text table and stores the two resulting characters in memory.

name: store_constant_sixteen
description: Stores the constant 16 in a global variable and returns the low byte of the data register unchanged; no other work is shown.

name: clear_state_cells_init
description: Zeroes a series of fixed memory cells and stores the constant 15 in one global variable, returning the data register unchanged; it is reached from the program entry and only initialises state.

name: dispatch_on_state_flags
description: Returns early when a flag byte is set; otherwise it branches on the sign of a second state byte, calling two routines when a pair of state values is set and clearing a result cell or calling one routine otherwise.

name: dispatch_on_state_flags
description: Returns early when a flag byte is set; otherwise it branches on the sign of a second state byte, calling two routines when a pair of state values is set and clearing a result cell or calling one routine otherwise.

name: dispatch_negative_state_branch
description: Branches on the sign of a state byte: when it is negative, calls two routines if a pair of state values is set and clears a result cell otherwise; when it is non-negative, calls one routine.

name: clear_result_or_call_pair
description: Clears a result cell when a word field or a flag byte in the record addressed by A6 is zero; otherwise calls two routines. The stack value is returned unchanged.

name: call_two_routines_passthrough
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns the stack value unchanged; no other work is shown.

name: countdown_and_poll_sequence
description: Decrements a countdown word in the record addressed by A6 and returns while it is non-zero; on reaching zero it reloads the countdown from a stored value and repeatedly calls routines, testing status fields after each call, until both status fields are non-zero.

name: copy_countdown_then_poll
description: Copies a word from a record addressed by A5 into the countdown field of the record at A6, then calls routines in a loop until the status fields are both non-zero.

name: poll_routines_until_status_set
description: Repeatedly clears a status byte and calls up to eight routines in a fixed chain, testing the status after each call, and returns once a call sets it.

name: decode_table_entry_bands
description: Fetches a longword from a table indexed by a word field and classifies its low byte by value band; one band copies a byte and masks a word, while the other bands branch to further handlers.

name: decrement_or_decode_entry
description: Decrements a delay word and returns while it is non-zero; otherwise it fetches the next table entry and classifies its low byte by value band, as its neighbour does.

name: fetch_classify_table_entry
description: Fetches a longword from a table indexed by a word field, classifies its low byte by value band, and calls three routines in the matching branch.

name: dispatch_nibble_jump_table
description: Masks a nibble out of a computed value and dispatches through a switch-style jump table on the result; the jump-table targets are not fully recovered by the decompiler.

name: advance_index_and_fetch_entry
description: Increments an index word and fetches table entries in a loop, returning once a fetched low byte falls outside one value band.

name: load_record_from_table_entry
description: Reads a word from a table computed from a record field and, when it is not a sentinel constant, copies it and derived pointer and counter fields into the record.

name: load_three_record_entries
description: Stores three words read through a source pointer into record fields and, for each non-negative word, derives an address from an offset table and resets the matching counter and index fields.

name: update_countdown_fields
description: Calls three routines, then decrements several countdown fields with routine calls between steps, and advances a stored index when one counter reaches zero.

name: update_record_countdowns
description: Reads a pointer from a record, then decrements countdown fields in that record and in the record addressed by A6, calling routines between steps and reloading a byte counter from a companion field when it reaches zero.

name: clear_flag_update_countdown
description: Clears a flag byte, calls three routines and runs a countdown step like its neighbour; the facts list the interrupt enable and request registers as touched, which the visible body does not show.

name: dispatch_record_state_switch
description: Loads a table entry into a record slot and switches on the byte it held; the first case clears several record fields and copies words to global variables.

name: increment_record_counter_word
description: Adds one to a word field at offset 64 in the record addressed by A5 and returns.

name: decrement_timer_and_accumulate
description: When a flag byte in the record at A5 is set, adds a byte value to a short accumulator and, if a companion field is zero, mirrors the sum into a second record; it then decrements a counter byte and, at zero, reloads it from a companion byte and inverts and increments a byte field.

name: step_value_toward_target
description: Ticks a counter byte in the record at A5 and, when it expires, moves a stored word toward a target word by a step amount, snapping to the target when it is reached.

name: accumulate_and_wrap_eleven_bits
description: Adds a word to an accumulator field in the record at A5; when the sum reaches a limit it resets the accumulator and reloads a base word, then stores that word masked to eleven bits into two fields.

name: gated_step_byte_toward_target
description: When a pending flag byte is set, copies it into an active byte and steps a position byte toward a target byte by a step size, clearing the pending flag when the target is reached.

name: step_byte_and_settle
description: Copies a pending flag byte into an active byte, steps a position byte toward a target by a step size, and when it reaches the target snaps it there and clears the pending flag.
